detailed_descriptions.en: By day, this city knows you. By night, it has no idea who you really are. The criminal ’90s have come to Severodvishchensk, a small, poor town torn in two by dangerous gangs. Residents fear for their lives and never cross anyone stronger, no matter who you are, human or beast. There’s no shortage of people here who never live to see old age, but will you end up among them? YOU ARE A HITMAN You’re Robert, a fox who makes a living carrying out his boss’s dirty orders. No questions asked: you take the job and see it through. But this harsh winter, something in you breaks. You start doubting who you really are and what you deserve. Painful memories surface one after another, each dragging you back into a past you wanted to bury... LIVE BY DAY Walk the streets while they’re still quiet. Explore an authentic, nostalgic, aging post-Soviet city that brutal gangs are tearing in two. Get to know the locals’ stories: help a friend climb out of a string of drinking binges; give your sweet cat-girl friend a chance to get closer to you; ask about the life of your bartender acquaintance and the VHS tape seller; hear about the hard life of the homeless in the abandoned building. Go check on your mom, for crying out loud! KILL BY NIGHT Every bloody job comes in at sundown. A fast, brutal top-down night-time bloodbath: kick in doors, choose from 20 different guns, go in fast or strike from the shadows. Your goal is to clear every location completely. Take out snipers, heal with medkits, shoot through windows from outside, and blow up fuel barrels. Get it done and carry out your damn orders! FEATURES: Day/night structure: story-driven gameplay by day, top-down action by night Crime drama with personal choices that affect the ending Adrenaline-fueled gang shootouts, 20 weapons, and plenty of locations Humans and anthropomorphic animals living in one world Original soundtrack by Acryl Madness, isekaifromsaratov, and Myasorubin A nostalgic post-Soviet winter, drawn by people who grew up in it themselves

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
By day, this city knows you. By night, it has no idea who you really are.

The criminal ’90s have come to Severodvishchensk, a small, poor town torn in two by dangerous gangs. Residents fear for their lives and never cross anyone stronger, no matter who you are, human or beast. There’s no shortage of people here who never live to see old age, but will you end up among them?

YOU ARE A HITMAN

You’re Robert, a fox who makes a living carrying out his boss’s dirty orders. No questions asked: you take the job and see it through. But this harsh winter, something in you breaks. You start doubting who you really are and what you deserve.

Painful memories surface one after another, each dragging you back into a past you wanted to bury...

LIVE BY DAY

Walk the streets while they’re still quiet. Explore an authentic, nostalgic, aging post-Soviet city that brutal gangs are tearing in two. 

Get to know the locals’ stories: help a friend climb out of a string of drinking binges; give your sweet cat-girl friend a chance to get closer to you; ask about the life of your bartender acquaintance and the VHS tape seller; hear about the hard life of the homeless in the abandoned building. Go check on your mom, for crying out loud!

KILL BY NIGHT

Every bloody job comes in at sundown. A fast, brutal top-down night-time bloodbath: kick in doors, choose from 20 different guns, go in fast or strike from the shadows.

Your goal is to clear every location completely. Take out snipers, heal with medkits, shoot through windows from outside, and blow up fuel barrels. Get it done and carry out your damn orders!

FEATURES:

  • Day/night structure: story-driven gameplay by day, top-down action by night

  • Crime drama with personal choices that affect the ending

  • Adrenaline-fueled gang shootouts, 20 weapons, and plenty of locations

  • Humans and anthropomorphic animals living in one world

  • Original soundtrack by Acryl Madness, isekaifromsaratov, and Myasorubin

  • A nostalgic post-Soviet winter, drawn by people who grew up in it themselves
